data.title: Show compact signal quality metrics in master feedback

data.body: Review pass. Checked plan task_01KSWG6ZM2K2FA27BD5CJRQPHR.md and inspected master_feedback view, programStore, and SignalQualitySummary. Implementation sets default activeProgramId to master_feedback and adds compact left-to-right quality/common corr/slow waves/60Hz cards plus a small quality timeline above the waveform without importing the debug SignalPanel grid/PSD section. npm run build in eeg/frontend succeeds. Risk: SignalQualitySummary.tsx is currently untracked in git status, so it must be added before any commit/PR or the import will be missing from the delivered diff.

Implemented compact master feedback signal metrics: default active program is now master_feedback, and master_feedback renders quality score, common correlation, slow wave percentage, 60Hz noise percentage, and a small quality timeline above the waveform without embedding the full debug SignalPanel. Verification: npm run build passed in eeg/frontend. Independent review by agent:codex-reviewer passed; noted only that the new component remains untracked until staging/commit.
